name: evalFrom_of_pow
statement: List α} {s : σ} (hx : M.evalFrom s x = s) (hy : y ∈ ({x} : Language α)∗) : M.evalFrom s y = s

name: pumping_lemma
statement: List α} (hx : x ∈ M.accepts) (hlen : Fintype.card σ ≤ List.length x) : ∃ a b c, x = a ++ b ++ c ∧ a.length + b.length ≤ Fintype.card σ ∧ b ≠ [] ∧ {a} * {b}∗ * {c} ≤ M.accepts
